caption: A toy train is placed on its track and the track's power pack switched on, and the train begins to run.

sa.check: A toy train and a track with a power pack.
The train is placed on the track.
The power pack is switched on.
The train is still on the track before the pack is switched on.
The order is place, switch, run.

pc.expect: The train starts to move when the pack is switched on, and only then.
pc.fail: The pack is on and the train stays still to the end of the clip; or the train runs before the pack is touched; or the train moves while being placed; or the train runs with the pack switched off.

pc.expect: Before the switch the train is still; afterwards it runs steadily along the track and does not stop, start or reverse on its own.
pc.fail: The train stops and restarts with the pack untouched; or reverses; or the train jerks in place without moving on; or the track moves under the train.

pc.expect: The train follows the track, its wheels on the rails, round curves and along straights.
pc.fail: The train leaves the rails and runs across the floor; or floats above the track; or takes a curve by sliding sideways off the rails; or the carriages separate and run at different speeds.

pc.expect: The train and track are rigid toys; the track stays where it is laid.
pc.fail: The track bends or ripples as the train passes; or a carriage squashes; or the rails stretch.

pc.expect: One train with its carriages on one track; nothing appears, vanishes or passes through the track.
pc.fail: A carriage vanishes or appears; or a second train appears; or the train passes through the track or a tunnel wall; or carriages merge.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The train's colours, the track's layout and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The train changes colour; or the track's layout changes between frames; or the surroundings rearrange.
